fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Region
fields.help: Region where the router and NAT reside.

fields.label: Router
fields.help: The name of the Cloud Router in which this route policy will be configured.

fields.label: Type
fields.help: This is policy's type, which is one of IMPORT or EXPORT Possible values: ["ROUTE_POLICY_TYPE_IMPORT", "ROUTE_POLICY_TYPE_EXPORT"]

fields.label: Terms
Priority
fields.help: The evaluation priority for this term, which must be between 0 (inclusive) and 2147483648 (exclusive), and unique within the list.

fields.label: Actions
Expression
fields.help: Textual representation of an expression in Common Expression Language syntax.

fields.label: Location
fields.help: String indicating the location of the expression for error reporting, e.g.
'CEL expressions to evaluate to modify a route when this term matches.'\

fields.label: Match
Expression
fields.help: Textual representation of an expression in Common Expression Language syntax.

fields.label: Location
fields.help: String indicating the location of the expression for error reporting, e.g.
CEL expression evaluated against a route to determine if this term applies (see Policy Language).
List of terms (the order in the list is not important, they are evaluated in order of priority).
